name: AUX Layer
convention: OMX-27: 27 RGB LED keys addressed by key index 0-26, exactly matching the firmware strip.setPixelColor(index, 0xRRGGBB). key 0 = AUX (top-left). keys 1-10 = the 10 black keys (top row). keys 11-26 = the 16 white keys (bottom row). Each led is a colour "#RRGGBB"; "#000000" means the LED is off. keyMap lists each key's musical note. Controls (5 pots, the encoder turn/press, and the 128x32 OLED screen) carry text notes per state. Multiple states are alternative pages/modes of the same hardware.

states.name: AUX Layer (hold AUX, identical in every view)
states.notes: Identical in every view. 1/2 = Launchpad Left/Right, 11/12 = Launchpad Down/Up (octave-like), 13/14 = pot bank -/+ as on the normal OMX AUX layer. Mode row 15-22: Session, Clip Launch, Mix, Notes, Seq, Phrase, Beat Repeat, Control; the current view's key is brighter. Clip Launch row/column orientation is a page-1 encoder param, not a separate view. Keys 4, 23-25 dark. Most shortcuts flash a confirmation message on the OLED.

keyNotes.0: AUX (hold). LED mirrors the Novation logo (CC99) = M8 Live mode: purple off, M8's colour when Live; blinks red while Record is latched
keyNotes.1: Launchpad Left (CC91), msg TRACK < - with Shift latched (AUX+3 first) = M8 Live mode toggle, msg LIVE MODE
keyNotes.3: Launchpad Shift (CC90), latched until AUX is released; blinks; msg SHIFT ON/OFF
keyNotes.5: Launchpad Project view (CC98), msg PROJECT / SEL PROJECT with Shift
keyNotes.6: Store snapshot (Shift + SShot CC1) - shows message
keyNotes.8: Latch Launchpad Record held (CC10) - AUX blinks red while latched
keyNotes.11: Launchpad Down (CC70), msg DOWN - notes down a row (octave-like)
keyNotes.12: Launchpad Up (CC80), msg UP - notes up a row
keyNotes.13: Pot bank previous (same as the normal OMX AUX layer)
keyNotes.16: Clip Launch view (sends Session CC93); row/column orientation is a page-1 encoder param
keyNotes.17: Mix view (sends Session CC93; OMX-side mute/solo page)
keyNotes.20: Phrase view (sends Seq CC97; right half of the sequencer screen)
keyNotes.22: Control view (M8 Control Map keys, two-handed; layout follows HAND)
keyNotes.26: Waveform display (Control Map: Up+Down+Left+Right on M-CH pressed together, as the classic macro)
